status_statement: EVIDENCE ARTIFACT ONLY. This crosswalk records what repository-registered sources do and do not establish for each already-registered feature. It is not an approved clinical schema, not a model input contract, not an authorization, not owner-verified timing evidence, not supervisor, ethics or institutional approval, and not permission to process a real cohort. No feature is clinically verified, no route is activated, and no scientific hold is lifted by this document.
offline_clauses: Read-only: the validator opens exactly one file (this crosswalk) and writes nothing.
No network access, no subprocess, no environment switch and no telemetry.
No backend route, database, migration, contract, frontend or model artifact is touched.
No scoring, inference, prediction, calibration or explanation path exists in this module.
No real patient data is read, stored or derived; every test fixture is invented in memory.
The result state of every query is METADATA_ONLY_NO_CAD_PROBABILITY_COMPUTED.

evidence_class_taxonomy.OWNER_DATASET_DESCRIPTION: Public dataset-owner landing page or attribute documentation. Establishes dataset identity, groups and published column names; it does not document per-field collection protocols or timing.
evidence_class_taxonomy.FROZEN_FEATURE_DICTIONARY_REGISTRY: Repository-frozen feature dictionary or stage allowlist. Establishes the registered working definition, unit and coding of a feature; it is a repository record, not owner timing evidence.
evidence_class_taxonomy.FROZEN_PROTOCOL_REGISTRATION: Registered exploratory protocol or experiment plan. Establishes what was proposed and executed internally; it grants no new permission.
evidence_class_taxonomy.MAINTAINER_LOCAL_READ_ONLY_AUDIT: Maintainer-executed, read-only, aggregate audit record. Establishes observed representation (for example numeric 0/1 cells); it does not establish direction, case definition or acquisition moment.
evidence_class_taxonomy.PEER_REVIEWED_SECONDARY_PUBLICATION: Peer-reviewed secondary publication. May support a provisional reading; it is not an owner codebook and does not establish timing.
evidence_class_taxonomy.PROPOSED_RESEARCH_MAPPING: Repository PROPOSED research mapping specification. Establishes a proposal under review, never an approved acquisition workflow.
evidence_class_taxonomy.REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE_REGISTER: Repository evidence/adjudication register. Records unresolved questions and eligibility classes without approving them.
evidence_class_taxonomy.REPOSITORY_TIMING_GAP_REGISTER: Repository register that documents the ABSENCE of owner timing evidence for a field. It is the positive record of an unverified-timing finding, not proof of any acquisition moment.

acquisition_channel_taxonomy.structured_history: Structured history capture by a clinician from the participant.
acquisition_channel_taxonomy.clinician_assessment: Clinician observation or interpretation recorded as a structured field.
acquisition_channel_taxonomy.measurement: Device or examination measurement recorded as a structured field.
acquisition_channel_taxonomy.laboratory_document: Routine laboratory report value transcribed into a structured field.

channel_status_taxonomy.VERIFIED_REGISTERED_SOURCE_DOMAIN: The proposed channel matches the source_domain/input_owner already recorded in a frozen repository register. Verifies domain only.
channel_status_taxonomy.PROPOSED_FUTURE_ACQUISITION_CHANNEL: The channel is a reviewable proposal with no registered source-domain record behind it.

timing_status_taxonomy.UNVERIFIED_TIMING_REGISTERED_DOMAIN_CHAN: The channel matches a registered source domain, but no owner-verified pre-angiography acquisition timing exists. A verified channel is not a verified measurement moment.
timing_status_taxonomy.UNVERIFIED_TIMING_PROPOSED_CHANNEL: The acquisition channel is itself only proposed, and no owner-verified pre-angiography acquisition timing exists.
timing_status_taxonomy.OWNER_VERIFIED_PRE_ANGIOGRAPHY: Reserved status: requires an owner-signed acquisition codebook or owner-attested CRF timestamp. No registered feature may carry it in schema version 1.0.0 because no such evidence item exists.

disposition_taxonomy.EVIDENCE_RECORDED_NO_ACTIVATION_CHANGE: Evidence recorded only. The feature's panel membership, route activation, authorization status and scientific holds are unchanged.
disposition_taxonomy.EVIDENCE_RECORDED_EXTENSION_REMAINS_BLOC: Evidence recorded only. The feature belongs to a blocked extension that stays blocked.

permission_status_taxonomy.AUTHORIZED_INTERNAL_EXPLORATORY_NOT_SUPE: D-047 internal exploratory Cleveland scope, executed only under the historical label; no publication, clinical or external-validation claim.
permission_status_taxonomy.SCIENTIFIC_HOLD_NEW_REAL_FIT: Scientific hold on new real-data fitting or panel extension pending owner/CRF timing evidence and independent review.

evidence_register.summary: Public UCI-412 owner landing page and attribute information: dataset identity, four feature groups, published column names and the >=50% angiographic target wording.
Frozen repository feature dictionary 1.1.0: registered working definition, unit, coding, source_domain, input_owner and the EXPECTED/PLAUSIBLE availability class. A repository record only.
AI-8R per-field evidence register (16 fields, pre_angiography=UNVERIFIED): documents unresolved semantics and the absence of owner timing evidence.
Maintainer-executed read-only aggregate audit recorded in Amendment A-1: six categorical columns are delivered as numeric 0/1 cells. Representation only; no direction, case definition or timing.
M3a/D-048 registered benchmark specification: registers the 23-column clinical core plus routine-labs panel as proposed-only. Authorizes nothing.
RH-02 source-question register Q-04: 0 of 16 UCI-412 fields has owner-verified pre-angiography acquisition timing.
Public UCI-45 heart-disease attribute information: processed column names, categorical codings and the >50% target wording. No per-field acquisition log or timing.
M2b stage-aware intake allowlist: frozen stage rosters and field definitions used by the synthetic-only intake prototype. Reproposed here as a repository register, not owner evidence.
D-047 internal exploratory Cleveland plan: registers the executed internal-only protocol. Confers no new permission and no timing evidence.
R1 PROPOSED five-field Cleveland mapping: records each field's proposed channel and states that pre-angiography timing is a workflow hypothesis the source does not certify.

sources.provenance_statement: UCI-45 heart-disease processed cohorts (DA-A2). Registered repository stage contract and D-047 internal exploratory plan; no owner codebook establishes per-field pre-angiography timing.
UCI-412 Z-Alizadeh Sani (DA-A1), CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.24432/C5Q31T. Registered feature dictionary 1.1.0 and AI-8R evidence register; no owner CRF or acquisition codebook establishes per-feature timing.

permissions.statement: D-047 internal exploratory Cleveland scope only, under the historical INTERNAL_EXPLORATORY_NOT_SUPERVISOR_APPROVED label. No publication, clinical or external-validation claim; this artifact activates nothing.

Scientific hold on new real-data fitting or panel extension pending owner/CRF acquisition timing evidence and independent review. No real data execution, model fitting or laboratory admission is approved.

restrictions.statement: Never pool UCI-412 with UCI-411 (same 303 participants) or Cleveland with Hungary, VA Long Beach, Switzerland or Statlog. No cross-source harmonization is approved.
No feature value, code, unit or target may be translated between the UCI-45 and UCI-412 schemas; this crosswalk records evidence only and defines no harmonized schema.
Synthetic results are software evidence only: never CAD performance, clinical validity, calibration or external-validation evidence.
A source, panel or model family is never selected because it shows the highest cross-dataset AUROC.
Cleveland has NOT been selected as the final project dataset; this evidence record is not a dataset-selection decision.
The UCI-45 resting-plus-labs extension (chol, fbs) stays blocked: staged lab availability, timing and missingness handling are unverified and execution requires separate authorization.
0 of 16 UCI-412 basic-clinical features has owner-verified pre-angiography acquisition timing. A verified registered source domain is not a verified measurement moment.
The UCI-412 clinical core plus routine-labs route stays blocked: the seven laboratory fields are proposed-only, timing is unverified and no laboratory admission is approved.

Hungary is a locked external target site: never trained, tuned, feature-selected or threshold-selected on; one-shot locked evaluation requires Gate PT P-3 plus separate dataset and ledger authorization.

no_result_contract.statement: Every query returns documentation metadata only. No CAD probability, score, calibration, explanation or clinical interpretation is produced, and none may be inferred from an empty or populated result set.

revision_history.change: Initial evidence-only crosswalk for all 30 features registered in the four existing panels and all five existing research routes: definition evidence, proposed acquisition channel, verified/unverified pre-angiography timing and source permission/restrictions, with a fail-closed offline validator and deterministic metadata query.
revision_history.authorization_impact: None. No route activation, permission, scientific hold, source status, model artifact, contract or workflow changes.
